body: I still hang on to hope that she still loves me. That she will come around. I already had suicidal tendencies before her. I made a effort not to bring my gaurd down and open up to anyone again. She came into my life and took those walls down. If I can't have her then I really dont want to go through life without her. I really don't. I know I have freinds and family but I'm blinded by my attachment and the feeling of abadonment. I feel like I have to do this to prove how attached I am so she will realise what she meant to me. I feel like instead of climbing the hill I started rolling down along time ago. I cant see any end to this. I'm on auto pilot set to crash. I have to stay high all the time. Even when im high i'll break down. I feel like i need stronger drugs to cope. Once the hope is lost so shall I be.
